name: Lockheed SR-71 Blackbird
summary: The fastest air-breathing crewed aircraft: Mach 3.3 reconnaissance at 85,000 ft, a titanium body with chines, two J58 engines with spiked inlets.

still.throttle: the package draws its throttle quadrant without separate levers, so there is nothing to move
still.controls: the package draws no control stick or rudder pedals in its cockpit

landing.note: Approximate: no flaps; drag chute on the rollout
